a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve can only fill one unit right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it silently. If you think there's a better split, say so.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.
